snippet.title: PC Engine Longplay [294] Gradius II: Gofer no Yabou
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Kage Negra

Just like the first Gradius, Gradius 2 has an extra level not available in any other port most notably the Arcade. That level would be the sand level. I cut out the deaths after the ending except for the last one so I could enter my high score. -
